what: BUY 6 MU @ 730.9002 on 2026-11-09 15:44Z on the headline 'Micron Will Buy Back a Hundred Billion Dollars of Stock at Four Times Earnings' (score 9: 'stock flat today, so not priced in'); sold at the -3% stop on 2026-11-10 15:56:16Z @ 707.9493; realized -137.70 (-3.14% of the position, -0.138% of the news book; the smallest possible stop-out was -135.82). Inside the owner's rules (score 9 > 8, 4.39% of the book, stop at -3%). Why it lost: (1) wrong input - the scorer was sent -0.1241 as today's move while MU was +5.82% on the day; replays of the headline give a 9 in 5 of 18 calls with the input as sent, 0 of 18 with the right move, 7 of 15 with no move; (2) the headline was commentary - a blog post about a TV guest's remark of 2026-11-06; Micron's authorization is 35.16B USD and it filed nothing; (3) the move was done - MU was +5.72% when the headline came out (91.5% of the day's gain) and moved +0.09% from publication to the buy; (4) the buy line sits inside the scorer's spread - the same input returns 7, 8 or 9. Ops: on 2026-11-10 the engine was down for 19 min 23 s of the 86 min MU was held in session and MU traded under the stop 14:31-14:35Z unseen; that did not enlarge the loss (a sale in those minutes: -135.82 to -175.46). Decision miss: the input defect was known at 03:29Z, eleven hours before the open, and the position was left to its stop. Sources: state/news_trades.jsonl rows 1-2, state/news_scores.jsonl row 91, logs/2026-11-10-loss-postmortem.md.
lesson: A number handed to the scorer is part of the decision: one wrong 'move today' turned a 0-in-18 buy into a 5-in-18 buy. A position opened on data later found wrong is closed at the next live quote, not left to its stop. One scorer call at the buy line is noise, commentary is not an event, and a polled stop protects only while the engine runs.
fix: Fixed and enforced: the move input (896cc1f); no buy on an unknown move and a missing day is an unknown move; stops are looked at first, between batches and after any slow call; the book is saved with every trade; an alert when a stop traded unseen; one engine per book, started as a tracked background task; buys wait for the review of a news loss; early exit on defective data is in the law. On trial in log mode, a rule change for the owner and rule 4: no-chase, second check, stop cooldown. News buys are on hold (news-hold, set 2026-11-10 19:42Z) until the owner decides. Open: backlog 33-44 (seal the scorer, the queue at the open, stop distance, overnight holds, supervisor).
